target: task-orchestrator chronicle instrumentation: emit task.completed/failed/blocked + workflow.phase_changed capture events at the real workflow-transition source (the Kotlin jar / workflow-api), so orchestrator work reaches the chronicle.
invariants: Every event stream must have >=1 publisher and >=1 consumer.
Fail-closed on protection/identity; fail-open on advisory/telemetry.
Deploy runtime proof required; no build-then-strand.

pr.title: feat(task-orchestrator): emit workflow chronicle events
pr.body: Workflow transitions don't emit task.*/workflow.phase_changed to the chronicle. Instrument the transition source.
